text: [excited] At the first AI music awards... humans lip-synced for the robots!
The red-carpet reporter was an AI, stuck inside a fake stone tower. [deadpan] It couldn't move.
[annoyed] The AI announcer kept talking over the hosts.
The show started thirty minutes late. One award took thirteen minutes.
A movie trailer finally played... [laughs] and cut off right before the star's face.
[curious] The big winner? An AI singer. [excited] Artist, song, AND album of the year!
[playfully] Would you watch an AI awards show? Send this to a friend who hates AI music.
